mission_2.prediction: I predict that A* with finish sooner than DFS on the constrained map. In Mission 1, A* found a path of 24.5 meters, while DFS found a much longer path of 50 meters. Since A* uses a heuristic to find a shorter path, I think the robot will need to travel less distance and will get to the goal faster.
mission_2.performance: My prediction was supported because A* performed better than DFS on the constrained map. A* was able to reach the goal in 90.0 seconds and traveled 23.91 meters, while DFS failed after 144.6 seconds and traveled 31.47 meters. Looking at the graphs, we can see that DFS planned a route with a lot of unnecessary turns, and the robot rounded several of the sharp turns, and the execution eventually failed with Nav2 controller error 104. For example, at checkpoint 723, the robot was making one of these turns, and its estimated path error was 0.09 meters. This shows that finding a path doesn't always mean that the robot will be able to successfully reach its goal.
mission_2.choice: Looking at the results, I would choose Nav2 as my delivery planner because it succeeded on both maps and had the fastest execution times among the successful planners. On the open map, it reached the goal in 35.6 seconds, while on the constrained map, it reached the goal in 73.4 seconds. In comparison, A* was also successful on both maps, but it took 46.4 seconds on the open map and 90.0 seconds on the constrained map. Nav 2 also traveled shorter distances, 10.10 meters on the open map and 20.60 meters on the constrained map, compared to A* with 13.17 and 23.91 meters. I think the most important advantage for a delivery robot is being able to reach its destination successfully and quickly, which is why I would go with Nav 2.
